I will put most of my land into winter wheat followed by summer maize, because that is the system I have worked for many years and I can manage it with less uncertainty. I will keep a smaller piece in cotton, because I already grow it and it gives me some cash income, but at my age I do not want to expand it too much because it needs more labor and more careful pest control. I will use improved seed for wheat, hybrid seed for maize, and improved cotton seed, with moderate fertilizer and irrigation rather than pushing for the highest possible yield. I will use rotary tillage because it is easier and saves labor compared with deep ploughing, and I will keep pesticide sprays to a practical level instead of spraying too often.
